phase_name: Redeploy, Full-Gate Correctness, and the Measured Before/After

objectives.description: Redeploy via deploy-headless.sh; confirm cache store survives regeneration
Confirm no task-number/record-versioning language under agent-system/**
Run the complete gate set with an explicit target; prove finding-set equivalence
Fix manifest-registration gap for the two new gate-3 test suites (discovered via gate 3 post-redeploy)
Re-confirm stalled-gate/timed-out-gate no-cache-entry contract on the real corpus
Measure and record the final per-gate before/after and the incremental warm-cache headline figure

approaches_tried.reason: A full --runs 2 timing pass over all 161+ discovered suites would cost well over the two complete battery runs already paid for directly in this phase (easily 20-40+ minutes on this contended host). The file is documented as advisory/optional (degrades to worse scheduling, never incorrect behavior) and is already reasonably current from Phase 10's comprehensive regeneration plus Phase 11's two added rows; left as a low-risk follow-up.

approaches_tried.approach: Repeated full 24-gate batteries at several --jobs worker counts to prove determinism
approaches_tried.reason: Per this dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral directive: worker-count determinism was already exhaustively proven for gate 3 (Phase 11, CED_JOBS=1/2/3/4/8) and for the gate-level pool generically (the inherited framework task's own test-gate-registry-resolution.sh cases, re-run clean this phase). Running several MORE complete 700-1400s batteries purely to re-confirm an already-established property was judged not worth the host time, given a properly idle host was not available for most of this phase's own work.
